title: This platform gives you ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and 17+ other AI models for life for $54.97
excerpt: 20+ AI models for a one-time fee
content_html:
TL;DR: ChatPlayground gives you access to 20+ AI models, and a lifetime subscription is only $54.97.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$54.97
$619 Save $564.03

Anyone who has used AI knows that one model can be incredible at one type of task and then laughably awful at something that seems extremely similar. ChatGPT may be great at writing emails, but ask it to write anything longer, and you run into a wall. That’s why it’s so common to use multiple models, but paying for each one is expensive. If you want a smarter way to work, ChatPlayground is a new platform that gives you 20+ popular AI models, and a lifetime subscription is only $54.97 (reg. $619).

Using ChatPlayground is really simple. Just enter a prompt, choose which models you want to send it to, and watch results come in. Seeing them lined up side by side makes it so much easier to compare the output from different models, and then you just pick the one that works for you. You can finally close all your other AI tabs and let your computer breathe.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

It’s not all text. You can also generate images with top AI image models, work on code, and tune your prompts for sharper responses, all in the same interface. Upload a PDF or an image, and the models answer questions about that document directly, so research and reference work all stays in the same place.

Your chat history stores records of past conversations, so you can always go back and check previous results. The Unlimited plan also includes priority access to new features and future models as they land, which is really important because even the most popular AI models are still in their infancy.
